Purpose of the Role:-
To own and drive product strategy for a consumer-facing (B2C) product area at Park+ — from identifying user problems to shipping and scaling AI-powered solutions. The role focuses on building products used by millions of vehicle owners, with AI and automation at the core of how problems get solved.

Key Responsibilities:-
Product Ownership: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for a consumer-facing product area — from discovery and problem definition to roadmap, execution, and post-launch iteration.
-
Roadmap & Prioritization: Translate user research, behavioral data, and business goals into a clear, prioritized product roadmap.
-
AI & Automation: Identify opportunities to apply AI/automation — LLMs, ML models, RAG, OCR — to reduce manual effort, improve product experience, or unlock new capabilities.
AI Feature Delivery : Own end-to-end delivery for at least one AI-powered or automated feature, from idea to adoption, partnering closely with engineering and data teams.
Metrics & Experimentation: Define and track success metrics for every feature shipped; run experiments (A/B tests, funnel analysis) to validate impact.
-
Customer Focus: Deeply understand the end consumer through user interviews, support tickets, analytics, and market research; represent their voice in every decision.
-
Stakeholder Communication : Communicate roadmap, outcomes, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
-
Data & Insights: Track product and funnel metrics (activation, retention, conversion, CAC/LTV, etc.) and derive actionable insights to improve the product experience.
-
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and Business/Growth teams to ship and scale features end-to-end.

• 3–6 years of experience in Product Management, with proven ownership of consumer-facing (B2C) products

• Hands-on experience building or driving adoption of AI/automation-powered product features (LLMs, ML models, RAG pipelines, OCR automation, chatbots, recommendation engines, etc.)

• Strong grasp of product metrics and funnel thinking — comfortable citing real numbers (conversion lift, CAC reduction, retention improvement) tied to your work

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, design, data, and business teams

• Strong analytical skills — comfortable with Excel, SQL, and analytics platforms (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar) for data-driven decision-making

• High ownership, adaptability, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

• B.Tech

Key Interactions
- Internal: Engineering, Design, Data Science, Business/Growth teams, Leadership
- External: AI/ML tooling vendors, research & UX agencies, Consultants (if applicable)

Job Title: Business Analyst (Data) Power Market

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 25 Years

Location: Gurugram

About GNA Energy

GNA Energy is a CERC-regulated entity building next-generation digital infrastructure for Indias electricity sector. With deep expertise in market design, utility operations, data management, and artificial intelligence, GNA Energy supports Indias transition toward a smarter, data-driven power ecosystem.

Our flagship platform, GNAi, unifies high-resolution power and market data using advanced AI/ML forecasting, optimisation, and simulation tools to provide real-time intelligence for utilities, traders, generators, regulators, and large consumers.

Vidyut AI, our AI-powered agent, enables natural-language access to complex power-system datasets, delivering instant insights, summaries, analytics, and decision support.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Business Analyst (Data) who can go beyond numbers - someone who understands client needs, translates unstructured business problems into analytical solutions, and takes ownership of delivery end to end. This is a client-facing role that requires equal parts technical depth and communication ability.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement and Delivery

Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, managing expectations and ensuring timely delivery Engage directly with clients to understand and articulate unstructured or ambiguous problem statements into clear analytical briefs Present findings, insights, and recommendations to clients in a clear and structured manner Ensuring that all Client deliverables are timely, error free, and exceed client expectations, including models, reports, BI platform, etc. 

Data Analysis

Analyze large and complex datasets from power sector sources including exchanges, regulators, generation and distribution companies Review raw data as well as final output for accuracy, consistency, and business relevance Identify trends, anomalies, and patterns relevant to power market dynamics 

Model and Output Review

Review AI/ML models from a business perspective - assess whether outputs are aligned with the problem statement and are fit for client use Maintain and monitor existing models to ensure continued accuracy and relevance Identify gaps and recommend improvements in models and analytical frameworks 

Project Management

Manage multiple analytical projects simultaneously, tracking timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communication Coordinate with internal teams to ensure quality and on-time delivery 

What We Are Looking For

25 years of experience in a business or data analyst role, preferably in the power or energy sector Proficiency in Python is mandatory; SQL and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI) are required Ability to independently understand and reframe unstructured problem statements Strong client-facing and communication skills - written and verbal Experience reviewing AI/ML model outputs from a business lens Detail-oriented with a high standard for data quality at every stage - raw to final output Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment 

How To Apply

Send your CV to hidden_email with the subject line: "BA (Data) Application (Your Name)" Please include details of your relevant experience, key projects handled, and why you are the right fit for this role. .

7a7bc2755c1cda51.description: **Stack: Node.js (TypeScript) · PostgreSQL · Prisma · Redis · BullMQ · Razorpay · FCM · GitHub Actions · AWS** **Experience : Minimum 3 years Positions : 2 Budget : 6-18 LPA** We're building a quick-commerce startup in NCR focused on delivering construction and building materials to active sites within 60 minutes. Think Blinkit for builders and contractors — electricals, cement, paint, plumbing, hardware — delivered fast. We're pre-launch, moving quickly, and looking for the right people to build this right. We're hiring our first dedicated backend engineer. Everything server-side is yours to own and build from scratch. What you'll own * Core APIs for multi-hub inventory management, order lifecycle, vendor procurement, purchase orders, and financial reconciliation * Inventory consistency under concurrent orders — reservation locking, oversell prevention, stock ledger accuracy across multiple fulfilment hubs * Payment integrations: Razorpay (UPI, card, COD, webhooks, settlements, refunds), OTP + SMS + WhatsApp (MSG91), push notifications (FCM) * Full DevOps setup — CI/CD, staging + production environments, secrets management, deployments * Observability: structured logging, error monitoring, uptime alerting, performance tracking * Database design, indexing strategy, query optimization, backup and recovery * Background job infrastructure: async processing, retry logic, dead-letter queues (BullMQ + Redis) * GST invoice generation, vendor payout scheduling, COD reconciliation What we're looking for * 4–5+ years backend experience on a transactional system — e-commerce, logistics, fintech, or quick-commerce * Strong Node.js in TypeScript — clean, typed, production-grade code * PostgreSQL depth — relational modelling, transactions, row-level locking, indexing, query performance. Not a MongoDB CRUD role. * Redis — caching, session management, rate limiting, pub/sub * DevOps ownership — you've set up CI/CD, managed cloud infra (AWS / GCP / Railway), and don't need a separate DevOps person * Payment gateway integration experience — idempotency, webhook reliability, failure handling * Background job systems — BullMQ, Bull, Agenda, or equivalent * Comfortable owning API contracts directly with a frontend engineer — no handoff ambiguity What this is not * Not a team of 20 with a DevOps engineer and a DBA doing the hard parts around you * Not a maintenance role — you're building greenfield from day one * Not for someone who needs specs handed down — you'll work directly with the technical founder on architecture decisions
